findings.title: Timed-out releases can outlive their claims and invalidate a subsequent seal
findings.detail: FIXED. releaseUnderClaim supplies both generation and metageneration to releaseHold. A failed precondition triggers re-observation, and another release requires successful rebasing under the claim at lines 101–110. packages/persistence/src/source/holds.ts:267 restricts rebasing to the latest unanswered live claim; migration 0020_source_object_holds.sql:350 also rejects expired claims. Both the seal cleanup and control runtime use this helper. The storage fake increments metageneration on placement at packages/application/src/testing/contract-fake-object-storage.ts:535 and checks the release preconditions before clearing the hold at :551. The exact prior reproduction is retained at apps/control/test/seal-holds.test.ts:602; assertions at :657–672 verify the delayed release fails, overwrite is refused, and the seal commits the live held generation. verify.log:681 records its pass; :682 records the failed-precondition/rebase controls and :540 the database guards. Real-provider qualification remains explicitly deferred to B15.
findings.reproduction: Pause failed-seal cleanup until its provider call times out, advance beyond the 910-second claim bound, complete a retry, then pause a new seal after its hold placement. Resume the original release and attempt overwrite. The release now returns PRECONDITION_FAILED, overwrite returns OBJECT_HELD, and the seal commits the original live generation.

findings.title: Excluded hidden columns remain excluded from projection counts
findings.detail: FIXED. findings.reproduction: Projecting an excluded hidden column fails PROJECTION_COLUMN_HIDDEN. Including it applies the formula policy, while the visible-column positive control succeeds.

findings.title: Lapsed unresolved cancellation secrets remain discoverable and purged
findings.detail: FIXED. Agency-paged discovery finds lapsed cancellation secrets and invokes cleanup at line 66. apps/control/src/storage-work.ts:246–248 purges the secret after its horizon without claiming cancellation confirmation or calling the provider. apps/control/test/storage-lifecycle.test.ts:295 retains the regression; lines 333–335 verify UNCERTAIN status, secret removal and no additional provider call, while lines 348–352 verify pagination past cleaned agencies. verify.log:686 records its pass.
